title: The Lowest-Caste Boy’s Rise to Power in Another World
description:
Ayumu Tachibana was constantly bullied and mocked by the girls in his class, sinking to the very bottom of the social caste. One day, he is suddenly summoned to another world.

But the world he arrives in is one where women are favored and men are treated as inferior. Forced into harsh underground labor, Ayumu reaches his breaking point and in that moment, the forbidden skill sleeping inside him awakens: Dominator's Eye, Herrschaft.

After rebelling against those who oppressed him and seizing his first victory, Ayumu meets Eir, the Eighth Princess. Together with her, he begins his rise from the very bottom to change the world.
author: Sora Hinokage
